skills.name: Intel Hardware Advisor
skills.tagline: Inspect the local inference environment before choosing an Intel execution path.
skills.purpose: A read-only hardware and runtime discovery skill that separates detected facts, documented facts, and uncertainty before an agent recommends a path.
when_to_use: You want to know whether the current Windows, Linux, or macOS machine exposes Intel CPU, GPU, or NPU capabilities.
You need a safe first diagnosis before installing OpenVINO or choosing a device mode.
You want a JSON evidence report that another workflow can consume.
workflow: Invoke the bundled hardware probe relative to the installed skill.
Collect platform, runtime, device, and lightweight configuration evidence without changing the machine.
Report facts, unavailable signals, uncertainty, and safe next steps separately.
boundaries: Does not install packages, change drivers, or run benchmarks.
Does not infer model compatibility or performance from a device name alone.
Does not depend on the internal harness or the optional Docs Reader.
skills.install: npx skills add michaeldouglas/intel-ai-skills --skill intel-hardware-advisor -a codex

skills.name: Intel Docs Reader
skills.tagline: Search and cite the versioned official OpenVINO documentation archive.
skills.purpose: A documentation retrieval skill for questions about OpenVINO APIs, devices, setup, configuration, and documented limitations.
when_to_use: You need a precise answer grounded in official OpenVINO documentation.
You need to compare setup or device behavior across a documented version.
You want source-page citations instead of an unsupported memory-based answer.
workflow: Search the local versioned documentation archive when available.
Use the bundled reader to obtain relevant pages and source identifiers.
Return a concise explanation with the source and known scope or limitation.
boundaries: Does not replace a hardware probe or install a runtime.
The local archive may need to be downloaded on its first query.
A missing or unavailable page remains explicit rather than guessed.
skills.install: npx skills add michaeldouglas/intel-ai-skills --skill intel-docs-reader -a codex

boundaries: Does not assume the optional Docs Reader is installed.

skills.install: npx skills add michaeldouglas/intel-ai-skills --skill intel-openvino-installer -a codex
